payload.description: Whose usage is wanted: you, this account on all its devices; all, every account added up, which only the admin may ask for and not while viewing as someone.

reply.description: The time spent in each feature on each of the last 182 days, oldest day first; a day and feature with no time is left out.

day.description: The day, by the browser's local date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

feature.description: The feature the time was spent in.

accounts.description: How many accounts the totals add up: 1 for you, the number of accounts with any usage for all.

error.description: signed-out: no one is signed in. not-admin: all was asked by someone who is not the admin, or while viewing as someone. unavailable: no total could be read.
